claims.object_text: expression present mainly in the brain; negatively correlated with seizures
claims.quote: the expression of stx1b was present mainly in the brain and was negatively correlated with seizures in a pentylenetetrazole (PTZ)-induced seizure zebrafish model.
The transcription of stx1b was inhibited by PTZ
The transcription of stx1b was inhibited by PTZ but rescued by valproate, a broad-spectrum epilepsy treatment drug.

claims.object_text: stx1b knockdown aggravates hyperexcitatory swimming and abnormal trajectory movements, particularly under lighting stimulation
claims.quote: In the PTZ-seizure zebrafish model, stx1b knockdown aggravated larvae hyperexcitatory swimming and prompted abnormal trajectory movements, particularly under lighting stimulation;

claims.object_text: stx1b knockdown increases c-fos expression in brain
claims.quote: In the PTZ-seizure zebrafish model, stx1b knockdown aggravated larvae hyperexcitatory swimming and prompted abnormal trajectory movements, particularly under lighting stimulation; at the same time, the expression levels of the neuronal activity marker gene c-fos increased significantly in the brain.

claims.object_text: stx1b overexpression attenuates PTZ-induced seizures in larvae
claims.quote: stx1b overexpression attenuated seizures and decreased c-fos expression levels following PTZ-induced seizures in larvae.

claims.object_text: stx1b overexpression decreases c-fos expression following PTZ-induced seizures
claims.quote: stx1b overexpression attenuated seizures and decreased c-fos expression levels following PTZ-induced seizures in larvae.

claims.object_text: deficiency of stx1b may be related to onset of clinical seizures, particularly photosensitive seizures
claims.quote: Thus, we speculated that a deficiency of stx1b gene expression may be related with the onset occurrence of clinical seizures, particularly photosensitive seizures.

claims.object_text: berberine (BBR) reduces seizure-like behavior and assists recovery of STX1B expression in larvae
claims.quote: In addition, we found that berberine (BBR) reduced larvae hyperexcitatory locomotion and abnormal movement trajectory in a concentration-dependent manner, slowed down excessive photosensitive seizure-like swimming, and assisted in the recovery of the expression levels of STX1B.

claims.object_text: BBR effects are reduced under STX1B downregulation; no effect on photosensitive overexcited swimming
claims.quote: Under the downregulation of STX1B, BBR's roles were limited: specifically, it only slightly regulated the levels of the two genes stx1b and c-fos and the hyperexcitatory motion of zebrafish in dark conditions and had no effect on the overexcited swimming behavior seen in conjunction with lighting stimulation.

claims.object_text: STX1B may partially mediate the anticonvulsant effect of berberine
claims.quote: STX1B may partially mediate the anticonvulsant effect of BBR.
